concept: A divider is a groove cut into the glass between two groups, shaded on its upper lip and lit on its lower one, the same as every recess in Pane.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a 1px grey border or <hr> rule (Material divider, Bootstrap hr)
default_to_avoid.why_not: a drawn grey line sits on top of the glass and owns a colour; Pane's light model makes edges from shade and light, not ink

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip
derivation.form: the divider is the thinnest recess: one hairline of shade over one hairline of light

derivation.consequence: the scene supplies the hue; the system owns no hue of its own, only white at opacities and one ink, and colour appears only where it states a status or marks a diagram
derivation.form: shade and light at low opacity, no grey of its own, so it takes the colour of the glass it is cut into

derivation.consequence: corners are continuous and nest, so an inner surface's radius is the outer radius minus the padding between them and a pane inside a pane reads as inside it; controls are full pills because they are held in the hand
derivation.form: an inset divider stops at the content inset, so it lines up with text instead of running into the pane's curve

variants.reason: A is the light model at its thinnest, a groove like every recess in Pane (P3 depth). B owns a grey colour the system does not have (P1). C fades into nothing on bright scenes and loses its job.

root.why: a hairline groove between two groups, so the layout reads the same everywhere it is used

horizontal.why: shade above, light below, across a column wherever the component is used in a screen

vertical.why: shade on the start side, light on the end side, between items in a row

inset.why: stops at the content inset so it lines up with the text

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours it is a plain CanvasText line
